name: Loop from Markaryd through an epic stretch of road 578
description: A loop through a favourite section rides it once and comes home another way. Found on a real ride (elsewhere): the loop rode to the section's far end and turned back along it, the favourite being cheap even ridden twice. Here a random 2 km of road 578, about 20 km east of Markaryd, rated epic: the loop must pass both ends and ride at most 10 % of itself twice outside the home zone.
